title: CTAB DNA Extraction Protocol for Mollusks
author: Lavanya M Vythalingam

steps.title: Prepare CTAB extraction solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 11.69 g sodium chloride, 3.33 g CTAB, 10 mL Tris‑HCl buffer (1 M, pH 7.5, Bio Basic Catalog #SD8124.SIZE.450ml), and 5 mL EDTA (0.5 M, pH 8.0, Life Technologies Catalog #AM9260G) in water and bring the volume to 100 mL; label as Teknova Catalog #C2190.

steps.title: Prepare CTAB dilution solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 2 g CTAB, 10 mL Tris‑HCl buffer (1 M, pH 7.5, Bio Basic Catalog #SD8124.SIZE.450ml), and 4 mL EDTA (0.5 M, pH 8.0, Life Technologies Catalog #AM9260G) in water and bring the volume to 200 mL.

steps.title: Prepare 0.4 M NaCl in TE
steps.instruction: Mix 16 mL 5 M NaCl (contributed by users), 2 mL Tris‑HCl buffer (1 M, pH 7.5, Bio Basic Catalog #SD8124.SIZE.450ml), and 400 µL EDTA (0.5 M, pH 8.0, Life Technologies Catalog #AM9260G); add water to a final volume of 200 mL.

steps.title: Prepare 1.42 M NaCl in TE
steps.instruction: Mix 24.8 mL 5 M NaCl (contributed by users), 1 mL Tris‑HCl buffer (1 M, pH 7.5, Bio Basic Catalog #SD8124.SIZE.450ml), and 200 µL EDTA (0.5 M, pH 8.0, Life Technologies Catalog #AM9260G); add water to a final volume of 100 mL.

steps.title: Slice tissue and add extraction buffer
steps.instruction: Using a clean, sterile scalpel, slice the tissue sample and place it into a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube containing 400 µL CTAB extraction solution (Teknova Catalog #C2190).

steps.title: Add Proteinase K and mix
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL Proteinase K (20 mg/mL, contributed by users) to the tube and invert gently to mix.

steps.title: Incubate lysate at 50 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at 50 °C for 60 minutes (longer if tissue is thick) and invert occasionally to mix until the sample is lysed.

steps.title: First chloroform/isoamyl extraction
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL chloroform/isoamyl alcohol (24:1, Acros Organics Catalog #327155000, CAS 67‑66‑3) to the lysate, gently shake to emulsify, then let stand at room temperature for 2 minutes while shaking the tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Spin the tube at 13 000 rpm for 2 minutes, then transfer the upper (aqueous) layer to a fresh 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Second chloroform/isoamyl extraction
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of chloroform/isoamyl alcohol (24:1, same catalog) to the transferred aqueous phase, mix gently, then spin at 13 000 rpm for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer to CTAB dilution solution
steps.instruction: Transfer the upper layer to a new 1.5 mL tube that already contains 900 µL CTAB dilution solution, gently invert to mix, and optionally place the tube in a refrigerator overnight.

steps.title: Pellet DNA by high‑speed spin
steps.instruction: Spin the tube at 13 000 rpm for 10 minutes to pellet the DNA.

steps.title: Wash pellet with 0.4 M NaCl in TE
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant with a micropipette, add 1000 µL 0.4 M NaCl in TE, and invert the tube to wash the pellet.

steps.title: Remove wash supernatant
steps.instruction: Spin at 13 000 rpm for 5 minutes and carefully remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Dissociate CTAB with 1.42 M NaCl
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL 1.42 M NaCl in TE to the pellet, invert until the pellet becomes transparent; if needed, gently shake at 37 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA in EB buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the DNA pellet in 50 µL EB buffer (use a smaller volume if higher DNA concentration is desired).

steps.title: RNase A treatment
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL RNase A (10 mg/mL, contributed by users) to the DNA solution and incubate for 30 minutes at 37 °C.

steps.title: Assess nucleic‑acid quality
steps.instruction: Measure DNA purity with a Nanodrop (A260/A230 ratio 1.8–2.0) and optionally determine concentration with a Qubit fluorometer.

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation of DNA
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL ethanol (previously stored at –20 °C) to the DNA solution, invert manually until precipitation is visible, and leave overnight at –20 °C for higher DNA concentration.

steps.title: Final centrifugation and drying
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at full speed (Eppendorf 5415 D) for 8 minutes, discard the supernatant, and dry the pellet either at room temperature or in a 37 °C heat block.

steps.title: Store DNA at –20 °C
steps.instruction: Transfer the dried DNA to a suitable tube and store at –20 °C until further use.
